admission.justification: The parsing pipeline, class cleanup and shared-mode selection together prevent repository HTML from executing or restyling the dashboard while keeping ordinary prose non-HTML.

applicability: HTML in rendered repository Markdown and the separate ordinary dashboard Markdown and notes rendering modes.
conditions: Only repository-document mode installs the raw-HTML parsing and sanitizing pipeline.
Raw identifiers receive sanitizer prefixing; generated heading identifiers are assigned after cleaning.
exclusions: Trusted application component markup outside Markdown content.
